title: After Being Scammed by Mystery Information
description:
Two months since you trusted the mystery tip and got scammed.
You'd lost money.
Today a similar type of information came in again.

choices.result_text:
You blocked it.
Once you've been burned, the pattern becomes visible.
Being scammed — had become a shield this time.

choices.text: Think maybe this time is different
choices.result_text:
You thought maybe this time was different.
That thought — creates the structure to get burned again.
Scams always come with the words "this time is different."

title: After Resolving the Mystery Information Situation
description:
Two months since you wrapped up the information incident and moved on.
You'd reached a conclusion one way or another.
Today you started to see whether that judgment had been right.

choices.result_text:
The result came.
Right or wrong — reaching a conclusion was what let you move forward.
Things left unresolved keep pulling you back.

choices.text: Think about how you'd handle a similar situation
choices.result_text:
You thought it through.
You used this experience as a reference point.
The value of experience — is that it becomes the standard for the next decision.

title: After Deciding to Double Down on the Resume Lie
description:
Two months since you chose to cover the resume lie and keep building on top of it.
Things had been going well at work.
Today a verification request came in directly related to that lie.

choices.text: Find a way to get through it
choices.result_text:
You got through it.
It worked this time.
But a lie — doesn't disappear. It gets more complicated.
The more you paper over it, the heavier it gets.

You told the truth.
The reaction was less severe than expected.
A lie — the fear of being found out is always bigger than the reality of being found out.

title: After Inflating Your TOEIC Score on the Resume
description:
Two months since you padded your TOEIC score on the resume.
There had been no verification yet.
Today a work situation arose where your English ability would show.

choices.text: Find a way to muddle through
choices.result_text:
You got through it.
This time it passed.
But without the ability — the situation keeps coming back.
Inflating a score doesn't replace the real skill.

choices.text: Admit the gap and decide to fill it
choices.result_text:
You admitted the gap.
And decided to fill it.
Even if you started with a lie — choosing to become real is still possible.
